description: Write every file staged by the open changeset to disk as one unit and return a per-file summary (created/modified, event/tile/record counts). Staged .json files are validated first: if any is invalid, nothing is written and the changeset stays open. Pre-images are journaled under .mcp-backups/changesets/<id>/ so undo_changeset can roll the commit back; a commit interrupted by a crash is rolled back automatically the next time the project is opened (the files found on disk are backed up first). Other edits are refused while the commit runs. If a commit fails and its files cannot all be restored, the changeset is closed and every edit is refused until undo_changeset has restored them. Until this is called, nothing of the changeset is on disk and reads reflect the staged edits. The RPG Maker editor must stay closed while the server edits the project.
name: commit_changeset
title: Commit changeset
